messages:
toni: FYI rolling RBAC tighten yesterday caused a couple of repos to show "status: scanned (partial)" in the dashboard. Looks like the scanner couldn't decrypt artifact manifests during SAST/DAST runs.

evan: ugh. saw intermittent failures in the nightly full-scan too. Any KMS denies in the audit log? :mag_right:

audit-bot: AuditLog: 2026-03-24T04:12:09Z - PermissionDenied - cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt - principal=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-inference.internal - resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scan/cryptoKeys/artifacts

lee: Confirmed. The RBAC playbook removed roles/*keystore* broad access and replaced with per-key roles. Looks like scanner SA wasn't included in the new binding for the artifacts key.

toni: That matches the failures. Immediate plan: 1) apply narrow decrypt privilege to scanner SA with an audit note, 2) requeue failed scans, 3) reconcile merged PRs that had suppressed findings, 4) adjust the RBAC rollout checklist and add a dry-run that validates runtime accesses.

evan: For the privilege, please do minimal scope: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt on the specific cryptoKey resource. Use the ephemeral-grant flow if possible.

zara: I'll do the ephemeral grant and watch heads-up. Using ephemeral-grant CLI: `ephemeral-grant grant --sa scanner@... --perm cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt --resource projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/artifacts --ttl 45m`

lee: Can you paste the exact IAM delta so we can attach it to SEC-2026-400? We need the before/after binding lines for audit.

zara: Pasted diff to ticket: `- members: [group:old-keystore-admins@redwood]` `+ members: [serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-inference.internal]` (role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter)

toni: Thx. Requeued the failing scans; juniper-repo scan succeeded on rerun. A few PRs previously merged with "scan incomplete" status need manual re-eval.

evan: For the runbook change: add a step that calls KMS test permissions for any service accounts referenced in CI templates. Proposed GH action snippet:```yaml
- name: Validate scanner SA KMS decrypt
  run: |
    gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scan/cryptoKeys/artifacts \
      --permissions=cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt \
      --impersonate-service-account=scanner@redwood-inference.internal
```

lee: Nice. Also add an automation that fails RBAC PRs if the dry-run shows missing perms for any CI principal. Rollouts should include a simulated CI check.

toni: We should also tag infra to add a lint for role diffs in the deploy tool so large removals prompt a checklist item: "notify owners of service accounts referenced by automation."

evan: Related detection idea: create an alert when scanner job logs contain "KMS.Decrypt: PermissionDenied" > 2 occurrences in 10m. That would've flagged during the rollout window.

audit-bot: Note: no data exfil detected. Deny events only; no Decrypt success followed by external transfers.

zara: On reconciles: I ran a quick grep for "scan incomplete" on merged PRs since the rollout and found 6 PRs. Will open follow-ups and tag owners.

toni: Action items: zara - apply ephemeral grant (done) and list PR follow-ups; evan - GH action + PR to runbook; lee - add gating rule to rollout tool; i'll write short postmortem summary and link SEC-2026-400.

evan: I'll sketch the GH action and include a small unit test that impersonates the SA and asserts test-iam-permissions returns the decrypt permission.

lee: Bonus: consider making the scanner use a dedicated key with a small access surface so RBAC changes are easier to reason about.

toni: Good call. We'll discuss key-per-service at next infra cadence. Closing when PRs + ticket updated. :white_check_mark:
